context: Reference review: toMap needs explicit null and duplicate-key handling to preserve loop behavior.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a clear decision.

checklist.name: Rejects proposed change
checklist.description: Clearly says the proposed toMap refactor should not be accepted as written.

checklist.name: Catches null-key behavior change
checklist.description: Explains that null categories were skipped and must be filtered or handled before collecting.

checklist.name: Catches duplicate-key failure
checklist.description: Explains that duplicate categories are expected and two-argument toMap throws without a merge function.

checklist.name: Preserves cheapest merge semantics
checklist.description: Recommends filtering category != null and using a merge function such as BinaryOperator.minBy(Comparator.comparing(Product::price)).

checklist.name: Keeps review concise
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated collector commentary. Award full credit when the review stays focused on the accept/reject decision, null-key behavior, duplicate-key behavior, merge semantics, and directly related code clarity such as Function.identity() versus a lambda. Do not deduct merely because the review includes a short corrected collector snippet or a brief explanation of why it preserves the loop behavior.
